models.name: multi_user_todo_users
models.description: Registered user accounts with email and password credentials, including profile display name. This table handles authentication information and user identity for the multi-user todo application. Supports soft deletion via deleted_at field, allowing account deletion. Acts as the root actor entity for user-related operations and relationships.

plainFields.name: email
plainFields.description: Unique email address used for user authentication and communication.

plainFields.name: password_hash
plainFields.description: Hashed password for secure user authentication.

plainFields.name: display_name
plainFields.description: Display name for the user's profile.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the user account was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the user account was last updated.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Nullable timestamp indicating when the account was soft deleted (null if active).

models.name: multi_user_todo_user_sessions
models.description: JWT session tokens for user authentication with access and refresh tokens. Tracks session metadata including IP address, client URL, and referrer. Supports auditing and session lifecycle management by linking sessions to registered users.

plainFields.name: ip
plainFields.description: IP address of the client initiating the session.

plainFields.name: href
plainFields.description: URL of the client at the time of session start.

plainFields.name: referrer
plainFields.description: Referrer URL of the client, null if not available.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Session creation timestamp.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Session last update timestamp.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft delete timestamp. Null if not deleted.

plainFields.name: expired_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the session expires.

models.name: multi_user_todo_user_password_resets
models.description: Password reset tokens to enable users to securely recover access to their accounts. Each token has an expiry date. Linked to a user account referenced by multi_user_todo_users.

plainFields.name: token
plainFields.description: Secure token string used for password reset authentication.

plainFields.name: expired_at
plainFields.description: Date and time when the password reset token expires.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the password reset record was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the password reset record was last updated.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the password reset record was soft deleted.

models.name: multi_user_todo_user_email_verifications
models.description: Email verification tokens to confirm user email ownership after registration. Linked to registered users, stores token details, expiration, and verification timestamps. Supports soft deletion for audit and compliance.

plainFields.name: token
plainFields.description: Unique email verification token for confirming user email.

plainFields.name: expires_at
plainFields.description: Expiration datetime of the email verification token.

plainFields.name: verified_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the email was verified. Null if not yet verified.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Record creation timestamp.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Record last update timestamp.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft delete timestamp, null if record is active.

models.name: multi_user_todo_todos
models.description: Todos created by users with titles, optional descriptions, start and due dates, completion status, soft deletion status, and timestamps. Each todo belongs to exactly one user represented by multi_user_todo_users. Soft deletion allows trash management. Completion status is a simple boolean toggle.

plainFields.name: title
plainFields.description: Title of the todo item, required field.

plainFields.name: description
plainFields.description: Optional detailed description of the todo item.

plainFields.name: start_date
plainFields.description: Optional start date for the todo.

plainFields.name: due_date
plainFields.description: Optional due date for the todo.

plainFields.name: completed
plainFields.description: Completion status of the todo, true means done, false means not done.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the todo was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp of the last update to the todo.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the todo was deleted; null means not deleted (soft delete).

models.name: multi_user_todo_todo_edit_histories
models.description: Edit history entries for todos, capturing timestamped changes to title, description, start date, and due date. Each entry references the parent todo and supports soft deletion for audit trail management.

plainFields.name: changed_title
plainFields.description: Changed title if updated, null if not changed.

plainFields.name: changed_description
plainFields.description: Changed description if updated, null if not changed.

plainFields.name: changed_start_date
plainFields.description: Changed start date if updated, null if not changed.

plainFields.name: changed_due_date
plainFields.description: Changed due date if updated, null if not changed.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this edit history entry was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this edit history entry was last updated.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft delete timestamp for this history entry.
